data.sections.effect.drawType.descriptio: Defaults to normal. Changes how effect is rendered. Options: normal|displacement (displacement only shows when shader effects are turned on)
data.sections.effect.life.description: Defaults 200. Time till effect is removed. Set low as possible to reduce effect overhead.
data.sections.effect.lifeRandom.descript: Random offset life by +/- this value
data.sections.effect.alsoEmitEffects.des: Create more effects when created, useful for meta-effects. Note: other 'alsoEmitEffects' on created effects are ignored.
data.sections.effect.alsoEmitEffectsOnDe: Create these effects when life runs out.
data.sections.effect.ifSpawnFailsEmitEff: If 'spawnChance' for this effects fails then emit these effects instead
data.sections.effect.alsoPlaySound.descr: Plays sound upon spawning the effect. Use OGG or WAV audio files. Appending a colon with a float value sets the volume
data.sections.effect.createWhenOffscreen: Defaults false. When true, effect is created when the unit is offscreen
data.sections.effect.createWhenZoomedOut: Defaults true. Effect is created even when the map is zoomed out. Set to false for improving performance
data.sections.effect.createWhenOverLiqui: Defaults true. Effect is created when the unit is over water
Defaults true. Effect is created when the unit is over land
data.sections.effect.spawnChance.descrip: Default 1. If less than 1 effect only has a random chance of being created
data.sections.effect.showInFog.descripti: Default false. When true, effect is still visible on fog of war
data.sections.effect.delayedStartTimer.d: Hide for x time before showing and updating effect.
data.sections.effect.liveAfterAttachedDi: Defaults false when attachedToUnit is being used
data.sections.effect.priority.descriptio: Defaults to high. verylow/low/high/veryhigh/critical. Takes effect when too many effects are being shown at once.
data.sections.effect.attachedToUnit.desc: Attach to unit or projectile that created this effect. Will move with this object. Useful for thrust effects
data.sections.effect.atmospheric.descrip: Apply drag to slow this effect down and add small wind effects
data.sections.effect.physics.description: Fall to ground and bounces. Needs height to take effect.
data.sections.effect.physicsGravity.desc: Defaults to 1. height speed acceleration when physics: true
data.sections.effect.xOffsetRelative.des: Offset starting effect position. Relative to direction of attached turret, projectile, unit
data.sections.effect.yOffsetRelative.des: Offset starting effect position. Relative to direction of attached turret, projectile, unit
data.sections.effect.xOffsetAbsolute.des: Offset starting effect by position ignoring direction of attached turret, projectile, unit
data.sections.effect.yOffsetAbsolute.des: Offset starting effect by position ignoring direction of attached turret, projectile, unit
data.sections.effect.xSpeedRelative.desc: Moves the effect sprite on relative horizontal position with specified speed. Negative will move left relative to source, positive will move right relative to source. Useful for thrust effects for moving units
data.sections.effect.ySpeedRelative.desc: Moves the effect sprite on relative vertical position with specified speed. Negative will move down relative to source, positive will move up relative to source. Useful for thrust effects for moving units
data.sections.effect.xSpeedAbsolute.desc: Moves the effect sprite on absolute horizontal position with specified speed. Negative will move left relative to map, positive will move right relative to map. Useful for smoke effects on structures
data.sections.effect.ySpeedAbsolute.desc: Moves the effect sprite on absolute vertical position with specified speed. Negative will move down relative to map, positive will move up relative to map. Useful for smoke effects on structures
data.sections.effect.hOffset.description: height offset from source. May be mistakenly confused with yOffsetAbsolute
data.sections.effect.hSpeed.description: Sets the speed to change the height of the effect
data.sections.effect.dirOffset.descripti: Sets the static direction of the effect
data.sections.effect.dirSpeed.descriptio: Sets the rotation speed of the effect
data.sections.effect.frameIndex.descript: Use a specific frame from strip index
data.sections.effect.frameIndexRandom.de: Use random frame from strip index
data.sections.effect.stripIndex.descript: A built-in image set to use. Cannot be used with custom image. Options: effects/explode_big/light_50/flame/effects/effects2/projectiles/projectiles2/explode_bits
data.sections.effect.image.description: Custom image file to use. Cannot be used with stripIndex.
data.sections.effect.imageShadow.descrip: Custom image file to use for shadows
data.sections.effect.scaleTo.description: Defaults to 1. Resizes the unit into the specified scale
data.sections.effect.scaleFrom.descripti: Defaults to 1. Resizes the unit from the specified scale
data.sections.effect.color.description: Defaults #FFFFFFFF. Changes the color of the effect sprite. Use pure white sprite for most use cases.
data.sections.effect.teamColorRatio.desc: Sets team coloration between 0-1. Team color is dependent from source unit
data.sections.effect.drawUnderUnits.desc: Renders the effect under all units
data.sections.effect.fadeInTime.descript: Fade alpha from 0% to 100% for this time at start
data.sections.effect.fadeOut.description: Fade alpha from 100% to 0% based on life. Set alpha is higher than 1 to delay fade
data.sections.effect.alpha.description: Capped between 0-1. Can be set higher than 1 to delay fadeOut effects
data.sections.effect.shadow.description: True to draw a shadow. Forced true if imageShadow is used
data.sections.effect.pivotOffset.descrip: Similar to dirOffset, this will also rotate relative keys and child elements
data.sections.effect.pivotOffsetRandom.d: Offsets pivot between +/- of specified value
data.sections.effect.total_frames.descri: Total frames of 'image', used with animation or frameIndex. Only needed with custom images
data.sections.effect.animateFramePingPon: If true, animation will go back and forth within the frames
data.sections.effect.animateFrameSpeed.d: Sets the animation speed. The lower the value, the slower it plays
data.sections.effect.animateFrameSpeedRa: Randomizes how fast the effect animation plays
data.sections.effect.animateFrameLooping: Defaults false. When false effect is removed when animation ends
